replies.text:
Here is how you can easily get there:

The JourneyFly: 
Grab a quick flight from London to Palermo or Catania in Sicily.

Bus or Train: Head over to the lovely port town of Milazzo.

Boat: Enjoy a scenic ride on a Liberty Lines hydrofoil straight to Alicudi.

🏨 Where to Stay

Hotel Residence Il Mulino: Right by the pier, offering beautiful sea views and easy access without the long walk.

Alicudi Giardino dei Carrubi: Tucked away up on the hill, it is wonderfully peaceful with breathtaking views.

⚠️ A Few Little TipsNo cars: 

The island is completely car-free, so everyone walks and sweet donkeys help carry the heavy bags up the stone steps.

Bring cash: There are no ATMs on the island, so it is best to bring enough Euros with you.
